wages.text: Supported increasing the minimum wage and giving workers a greater role in workplace decisions.
wages.quote: Increase the minimum wage and ensure workers have a seat at the table.

trade.text: Stanton touts helping pass the USMCA to strengthen trade partnerships and lower tariffs for exporters.
trade.quote: to strengthen Arizona's trade partnerships and lower tariffs for exporters and small businesses.

debt.text: Stanton criticized a spending bill for failing to safeguard Medicare, Medicaid and Social Security.
debt.quote: It fails to protect Arizonans' hard-earned benefits like Medicare, Medicaid and Social Security.

housing.text: Supported updating permitting and zoning rules to build four million homes over the next decade.
housing.quote: Cut red tape and update permitting and zoning to build four million homes in the next decade.

schools.text: Stanton opposes private school vouchers and says public money should strengthen public education.
schools.quote: Public money should be used to strengthen public education, not private school voucher schemes or corporations looking to profit off students.

safety.text: Stanton opposes defunding police and supports investing in officers and detectives.
safety.quote: Greg does not support defunding or disbanding local police departments.

immigration.text: Stanton cosponsors legislation creating a citizenship pathway for Dreamers and TPS holders while also backing border security.
immigration.quote: Proud cosponsor of the American Dream and Promise Act, creating a pathway to citizenship for Dreamers and people with Temporary Protected Status who have built their lives in the United States.

guns.text: Stanton backs common-sense gun safety laws to keep dangerous weapons away from dangerous people.
guns.quote: common-sense gun safety laws that keep dangerous weapons out of dangerous hands while respecting law-abiding gun owners

abortion.text: Stanton voted for the Women's Health Protection Act to guarantee nationwide access to abortion.
abortion.quote: In Congress, Greg voted for the Women's Health Protection Act to ensure every woman has access to reproductive health care.

health.text: Supported extending ACA tax credits, fully funding Medicaid, and strengthening Medicare benefits.
health.quote: Reduce monthly costs by extending ACA tax credits and expanding access to prescription price caps.

energy.text: Supported energy policies intended to lower residential energy costs and make energy infrastructure cheaper to build.
energy.quote: Invest in energy efficiency and home heating & cooling to lower residential energy costs.

voting.text: Stanton voted for the For the People Act to expand voting rights.
voting.quote: Greg also voted for and supported the For the People Act, a sweeping democracy reform bill that addressed threats to democracy by expanding voting rights, strengthening ethics reforms, and reducing the use of dark money in elections.

tax.text: Jasser says he would rein in spending and let people keep more of their earnings while cutting regulations.
tax.quote: That means reining in wasteful spending, letting Americans keep more of their hard-earned money, and cutting needless regulations so small businesses can thrive.

debt.text: Jasser supports a constitutional Balanced Budget Amendment to control federal spending.
debt.quote: I support a Balanced Budget Amendment to the United States Constitution.

schools.text: Jasser backs educational freedom and funding students rather than school systems.
schools.quote: I support educational freedom in education, and funding students — not systems.

immigration.text: Jasser says he would give border agents more resources to secure the border.
immigration.quote: I will support more resources for our border agents, as they have the tools and support to properly secure our border.

health.text: Jasser blames the Affordable Care Act and wants more competition and price transparency to lower coverage costs.
health.quote: He blamed the Affordable Care Act and a lack of competition and price transparency for making coverage increasingly expensive.

schools.text: Said she wants to find solutions for schools while preserving parent choice.
schools.quote: She also wants to target inflation and find solutions for schools while keeping parent choice intact.
